description: `coverageReporters: []` under Jest 30.5.2 with `--json` (T8.10, B23b): `--json` sets `useStderr`, and CoverageReporter adds its `text-summary` fallback only without it (`!useStderr && coverageReporters.length === 0`), so the run writes no report at all: stdout is empty and there is no coverage file. The recorder always passes `--json`; the fallback itself is held to a live Jest by `provino`'s `jest-coverage.test.ts`.
